name: Antoinette Tauk DDS
what_they_do: Solo-practitioner family and cosmetic dentistry practice (Antoinette Marie Tauk, DDS, LLC) offering adult and children's dentistry, Invisalign including accelerated Invisalign, whitening and specialist referrals, with a strong 'actual patients' smile gallery.
customers: North Brunswick families and adults; Invisalign/whitening cosmetic patients; parents choosing a family dentist for children.

size_signals.signal: One dentist (Dr. Antoinette Marie Tauk) with a 'Meet the Staff' page - inference: small practice, roughly one doctor plus hygienists/front desk
Listing badge 'New Jersey Top Dentists 2026' displayed on the homepage
5.0/5 ratings reported by two directories (45 and 22 reviews)

website_review.primary_cta: None functional - the phone number 732.940.0092 is plain text; there is no book/contact button
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: None - the Contact Us page only says to call 732-940-0092
website_review.trust_signals: Before/after smile gallery, testimonial videos, practice video, 'Actual Patients' photo carousel, NJ Top Dentists badge, staff and office-tour pages
website_review.out_of_date_signs: ProSites-style template with dated visual design; no copyright year visible in the footer text; no schema; homepage has no H1
website_review.search_basics: Title and meta description do name Dr. Tauk, cosmetic dentistry, Invisalign and North Brunswick; services are split into Adults / Children / Invisalign / Whitening pages rather than per-treatment service pages
top_issues: Phone number is not a tel: link on desktop or mobile, so there is no click-to-call on a phone
No contact form and no online booking anywhere - the contact page explicitly says to call
No schema.org JSON-LD and no H1 on the homepage
Hours are described in one paragraph ('Monday...Saturday 9-3') with a caveat that some days are administrative, so an agent cannot compute open/closed per day

agent_readiness.notes: Site is crawlable and the hours/service text is readable, but hours are not tabulated and there is no JSON-LD, so an assistant must interpret prose. Booking is impossible online: the Contact page says 'contact us directly at 732-940-0092' and contains zero forms and zero tel: links. robots.txt not checked.

operations_signals.signal: Every appointment must arrive by phone - the site has no form, no email address and no scheduler
After-hours calls go to an automated answering service ('follow the instructions on our automated answering service'), i.e. an existing phone-tree, not a digital intake
New patient forms are a separate web page rather than a digital intake flow - inference: paperwork is still completed at or before the visit by hand

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add click-to-call, a short appointment-request form and a real online scheduler - right now a mobile visitor has no way to act except dialing a number typed in text
top_opportunities.evidence: Zero tel: links and zero forms on the homepage and contact page; contact page instructs visitors to call

top_opportunities.opportunity: Write hours as a proper day-by-day table plus Dentist/LocalBusiness JSON-LD so agents can answer 'are you open Saturday' and route new patients correctly
top_opportunities.evidence: Hours exist only as one sentence on /content/office-hours with the caveat that some days are administrative; no ld+json on any page checked

top_opportunities.opportunity: Convert the phone-only intake into an AI receptionist that answers new-patient questions and books into the practice's calendar after hours
top_opportunities.evidence: Calls outside hours already fall to an automated answering service, and the site offers no digital alternative

scores.reasons: Clear, cheap-to-fix gaps (no click-to-call, no form, no booking, no schema) on a site that otherwise has good trust content; a solo practice has limited budget but this is small-ticket work; a one-person consultancy could ship click-to-call, a form and schema in days; all verified live in the browser.
